text:
ravi: Quick follow-up from the late-night GPU saturation postmortem. We need clear owners for quota backstop, scheduler tuning, and a runway alert card.

zoe: I can own the quota backstop. Plan: implement a soft reserve per-pool (10% default) + a hard-fail threshold at 93% that triggers background job spillover. ETA: 4 business days.

pat: I'll take scheduler tuning. Immediate action: decrease background packing aggressiveness and add a 20s evacuation damp to avoid repacking. Will run a 5-day trace sim and post p50/p95/p99.

ravi: ops-bot, create remediation tickets and add owners.

ops-bot: Created tickets: T-7781 (quota-backstop-impl), T-7782 (scheduler-eviction-tweak), T-7783 (runway-alert-card).

zoe: acceptance test snippet for quota backstop:

```
# test
ramp(batch_qps=3.5x, duration=900s)
assert(reserved_pct(interactive) >= 10%)
expect(alert='quota_soft', within=90s)
expect(pager='quota_hard', if=sustained(>93%, 300s))
```

pat: scheduler tuning note: propose new eviction score: `score = mem_frac*1.6 + cpu_frac*0.5 + age_secs*0.0007`. Also set `evict_damp_ms = 20000`. I'll stage this config and run microbenchmarks.

ravi: infra-bot, can we get per-pool mem_frac histograms for last 30 days? Pat needs them to tune thresholds.

infra-bot: Backfill job scheduled for 30 days. ETA ~3 hours. Will post when ready.

zoe: for the runway card, we want both linear 1h forecast and a model column (experimental). If linear runway < 30m and sustained growth > 4%/m then page. Add 15m cooldown on pages.

ravi: agree. ops-bot, add that rule to the alerting playbook.

ops-bot: Rule added to playbook: `runway_short_circuit` with cooldown 15m.

pat: blocker: need access to staging cluster GPU traces for the sim. @infra-sre can you grant read-only until job completes?

infra-bot: Granted staging-read to pat for 48h.

ravi: ownership recap: zoe -> T-7781 (quota backstop, due 2024-07-15), pat -> T-7782 (scheduler tuning + sim, due 2024-07-13), infra -> T-7783 (runway metrics + alert hookup, due 2024-07-14). I'll add these to the postmortem follow-ups and schedule a 72h check-in.

zoe: I'll add the acceptance tests to CI so merges are gated.

pat: will post sim numbers in 24h.

ravi: thanks all. If anything slips, escalate in this thread. :thumbsup:
